factSources.text: Venus describes attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, money, comfort, desire, and the conditions that help connection feel worth choosing. It shows what someone is drawn toward and what helps affection become real rather than only appealing. Venus moves through all twelve signs in about a year, with retrograde cycles that ask for review around love, value, beauty, money, and desire. Its sign describes the style of relating; its house shows where ease, attraction, and value become active. With Venus in Aquarius, your love is free-spirited, intellectual, and somewhat unconventional. You value friendship and shared ideals in your relationships, and you’re attracted to those who stimulate your mind and respect your need for independence.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Refined aesthetic and tender, imaginative affection. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

Connection and value meet disruption and freedom. Attraction runs electric, sudden, and unattached to convention. The trine makes this a natural strength: Exciting, unconventional bonds and an original aesthetic; freedom inside closeness. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
